entities.summary: Béla Tóth is a Hungarian-born Italian chess player who holds the FIDE title of International Master and the ICCF title of Correspondence Chess Grandmaster. He is a four-time Italian Chess Championship winner, a Hungarian Chess Championship medalist (1971), a Chess Olympiad individual silver medalist (1976), and a European Correspondence Chess Championship winner (1973-78).
